summary: An unknown threat actor abused Meta's business partner service to send validated phishing emails containing non-clickable URLs in the business name field. These lures led to phishing pages, some incorporating a chatbot, designed to steal Meta credentials, MFA codes, and ID documents. Stolen data was exfiltrated to a private Telegram channel, with some exfiltration messages containing Vietnamese-language strings.
